card.fact_statement: Sławomir Mentzen received 14.8% of the vote in the first round of the 2025 Polish presidential election.
card.source_span: while the right-wing candidates, Nawrocki, Sławomir Mentzen (Confederation) and Grzegorz Braun (KKP) overperformed polls, winning 29.5%, 14.8% and 6.3% respectively
